attributes.title: Dental Hygiene Continuing Education Conference (Winter Weekend 2027)
attributes.organizer: Old Dominion University School of Dental Hygiene
attributes.summary:
Old Dominion University's School of Dental Hygiene runs its Winter Weekend continuing education conference February 26 to 28, 2027. The courses are delivered as live and recorded webinars, and the school says attendees can earn 15 hours over the weekend.

There is one in-person piece: an exhibit hall and reception on February 27, 2027 from 6:00 to 8:00 PM in the Priority Club. Registration costs $200 through January 4, 2027 and $250 from January 5. Registration stays open until February 12, 2027; later sign-ups may be accepted if space allows, with a late fee.

The page does not list the course topics or the approval body for the credit. Check with the school (officeofodusodh@odu.edu) whether the hours meet your state board's rules for live or interactive online CE.
